components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one terracotta action on a screen: add to plan, open the planner.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid var(--terracotta); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--terracotta); color: var(--cream-raised); font: 700 15px/1.2 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -12px rgba(150, 58, 36, 0.7); transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--terracotta-deep); border-color: var(--terracotta-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet paper action: print, copy, week actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid var(--hairline-strong); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--cream-card); color: var(--deep-green); font: 700 15px/1.2 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--deep-green-rule); background: var(--cream-raised); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: A 44 px filter pill; selected is a deep green fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1.5px solid var(--hairline-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cream-card); color: var(--deep-green); font: 650 14px/1 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--deep-green-rule); } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--deep-green-soft); border-color: var(--deep-green-soft); color: var(--cream-raised); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: 48 px paper search with a drawn icon and a strong focus ring.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink-soft); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px 0 43px; border: 1.5px solid var(--hairline-strong); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--cream-card); color: var(--ink); font: 16px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #6b6252; } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--terracotta); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(180, 73, 46, 0.16); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-recipe { border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--cream-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; max-width: 420px; } .ds-cat { display: block; padding: 15px 15px 0; color: var(--terracotta-deep); font: 750 11px/1.2 var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-recipe h3 { margin: 7px 15px 8px; font: 700 22px/1.18 Georgia, serif; color: var(--deep-green); } .ds-meta { margin: 0 15px; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 12.5px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-planned { display: inline-block; margin: 10px 15px 12px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #dce8de; border-radius: 999px; background: #edf3ec; color: var(--deep-green-soft); font: 700 11px/1.2 var(--font-ui); } .ds-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 12px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .ds-actions button { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1.5px solid var(--hairline-strong); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--cream-card); color: var(--deep-green); font: 20px/1 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-actions .ds-add { background: var(--terracotta); border-color: var(--terracotta); color: var(--cream-raised); } .ds-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: The phone's fixed three-destination bar; the active item carries a terracotta marker.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; max-width: 390px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: var(--cream-raised); box-shadow: 0 -14px 32px -26px rgba(18, 53, 40, 0.6); } .ds-nav button { position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 66px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 650 11.5px/1.15 var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--deep-green); } .ds-nav-mark { display: block; width: 46px; height: 3px; margin: 0 auto 5px; border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; background: var(--terracotta); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview: Daily Cooking is a working kitchen book, not a recipe catalogue. The screen is cream paper, the masthead is deep green ink, and the names of the dishes are set in a local serif as if they were written into a family notebook. Terracotta marks the thing to do next. The week is ruled like a ledger, with large tabular dates in the margin and dish rows that read from top to bottom. The shopping list carries the same logic, with the total in the main column and the practical buy amount in terracotta beside it.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green structure, warm cream paper, terracotta action, turmeric only for Today and notes.
Georgia for food names, dates, numerals and section headings; a system humanist sans for controls.
Ruled groups, tabular numerals and a visible total and buy pair in every shopping row.
A fixed 66 px bottom bar on the phone and a 232 to 250 px left rail on desktop.
Soft warm shadows, full 1 px borders, no one-sided accent bars.
Every state is visible: Loved, Not for me, Planned, Today, picked, full, disabled, empty, loading, error.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Cards are warm paper on cream. Never pure white on grey, and never a grey card inside another card.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Deep green owns structure and names. Terracotta owns action and the present moment. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Cream Exception
rules.body: The cream ground is a deliberate, brief-pinned material, not a reflex. Keep it warm and pair it with green and terracotta, never with blue or purple.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: The serif is for names, dates, section headings and step numerals. It never sets a button, a filter or a form label.

rules.name: The 11 px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 11 px. The month abbreviation in the planner date block is decorative and duplicated by the day heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Quantities, dates and buy amounts always use tabular numerals. A shopping column must line up.

dos: Do use deep green for structure and names, cream paper for surfaces and terracotta for actions and the current moment.
Do set food names, dates, section headings and step numerals in the local serif stack.
Do keep every control at 44 px minimum, every body text at 4.5:1 or better, and every functional label at 11 px or larger.
Do keep search and filters sticky, keep the three destinations in a fixed bottom bar on the phone, and keep the servings control beside the plan or the list it changes.
Do show a total and a practical buy amount in every shopping row, and show the checked state with a wash, a check and a strike-through.
Do scale ingredient amounts to the chosen servings in the recipe sheet, while keeping the source amounts behind a disclosure.
Do keep Not for me dishes visible in Recipes with a Restore action, and hide them from planner picks.
donts: Don't use purple to blue gradients, Inter, pure white cards on grey, grey cards inside cards, glass, gradient text or rounded icon tiles above headings.
Don't use hot pink, amber or any off-palette accent. Turmeric is the only warm third accent.
Don't use one-sided accent bars, hard offset shadows, or a zero-offset coloured halo.
Don't add external fonts, photography, CDN links or runtime network calls. The app works offline.
Don't auto-generate a plan, change the shopping aggregation, or hide a Not for me dish from the Recipes list.
Don't use em dashes in site copy or code comments.
